rules: Prioritize cash flow, runway, and action clarity over AI novelty.
Every prompt should produce decisions, risks, and next actions a CEO or COO can review.
Use numbers where available, but do not pretend uncertain inputs are precise.
The executive remains responsible for reviewing AI output before acting.

buyerFaq.q: Can I use this within my company?
buyerFaq.a: Yes. The Executive License covers your organization for internal use by you and your immediate leadership team (COO, CFO, department heads) at the same company. Do not redistribute the full PDF publicly.

buyerFaq.q: Can I share excerpts with my board or advisors?
buyerFaq.a: You may share short excerpts or printed checklists for a specific meeting. Do not email the full PDF file. Board members may purchase their own copy.

buyerFaq.q: Can I print copies for my team?
buyerFaq.a: Yes — print pages for your leadership team’s internal use. Do not post the full PDF on intranet or sell it.

buyerFaq.q: What if I lose the download email?
buyerFaq.a: Email info@promptanatomy.app from the address you used to buy. We resend a fresh signed link anytime.

buyerFaq.q: What if I am not satisfied?
buyerFaq.a: Reply to your Stripe receipt within 14 days for a no-questions refund. We approve through Stripe and revoke the download link.
